qualifier: glycogen storage diseases of synthase, branching and lysosomal enzymes
name: Glycogen synthesis, breakdown and storage diseases
rationale: All members concern glycogen turnover (synthesis, glycogenolysis, glycophagy, glucokinase supply) and its inherited disorders (GYS1/2, GBE1, GYG1, GAA, Lafora, PGM1); unlike the confusables it centres on glycogen-building and lysosomal enzymes rather than glucose-6-phosphatase/hexose-phosphate transport or glucagon-PKA signalling.

qualifier: recombination, cohesion and chromosome segregation including female meiosis
name: Meiotic recombination, cohesion and chromosome segregation
rationale: All members are meiotic events (DSB formation, strand invasion, synapsis, chiasmata, meiotic cohesion, spindle positioning, polar body extrusion, meiotic checkpoints); unlike mitotic cohesion/condensation, germline epigenetic and DNA-repair confusables it spans the full meiotic chromosome programme.

qualifier: common gamma-chain (IL-2/7/9/15/21) and beta-chain (IL-3/5) cytokines in T and NK cells
name: Common gamma-chain and IL-3/IL-5 cytokine STAT5 signalling
rationale: Members are IL-2, IL-7, IL-9, IL-15, IL-21, IL-3 and IL-5 receptor signalling via STAT5/SHC with T and NK cell differentiation; confusables are FLT3-STAT5, IL-10/IL-12-family/interferon or Th2/mast cell inflammatory cytokine programmes.

qualifier: tachykinin receptor signalling in gut, uterus, bladder and penis
name: Tachykinin-linked visceral smooth muscle contraction and relaxation
rationale: Members are smooth muscle contraction/relaxation of gut (peristalsis, gastric motility), uterus (parturition), urinary tract (micturition) and penis (erection, mating), with tachykinin receptor signalling; confusables carry histamine, serotonin or muscarinic receptor signalling instead.

core: Forebrain neuronal migration and axon tract formation
qualifier: commissural and corticospinal tracts with radial glia-guided migration
name: Forebrain commissure formation and radial glia-guided neuronal migration
rationale: Members cover anterior commissure, corpus callosum and corticospinal tract morphogenesis together with radial glia differentiation, neuroblast division and radial migration; confusables emphasise cortical layering, tangential/interneuron migration or cerebellar development.

qualifier: transcriptional targets plus ARF/p16INK4A defects in senescence evasion
name: p53 transcriptional apoptosis and G1 arrest, ARF/p16INK4A defects
rationale: All members concern p53 regulation and its transcriptional programme for intrinsic apoptosis (PUMA, NOXA, caspases, death receptors) and G1 arrest (p21), plus ARF/p16INK4A loss enabling senescence evasion; confusables are senescence/SASP execution or the mitochondrial apoptosis machinery itself.

qualifier: MHC class II exogenous peptide loading
name: MHC class II antigen processing and presentation
rationale: Members are antigen processing and presentation dominated by MHC class II peptide loading, its regulation and B-cell/APC presentation modules; confusables are MHC class I cross-presentation and proteasomal processing or DC/T cell surface signatures.

qualifier: HNF4-driven brush-border enterocyte and hepatocyte programme
name: HNF4-driven absorptive brush-border epithelium of gut and liver
rationale: Nearly all members are HNF4A/HNF4G-centred modules of differentiated enterocyte/hepatocyte brush-border epithelium (one outlier, leukocyte migration); confusables are KLF5/EHF/EPCAM barrier epithelium or Wnt-driven crypt stem programmes.

core: Glutamate, glutamine and aspartate nitrogen metabolism
qualifier: with sodium-coupled di/tricarboxylate and SLC17 anion transport
name: Glutamine-glutamate-aspartate metabolism and dicarboxylate transport
rationale: Members cover glutamine/glutamate/aspartate metabolism, ammonium handling and the malate-aspartate shuttle together with succinate/citrate and SLC17A5 anion transport; confusables are the urea cycle, TCA/gluconeogenesis or carnitine/cationic amino acid transporters.

core: ER-Golgi vesicle traffic and Golgi organization
qualifier: COPII export and COPI retrograde transport
name: COPII/COPI ER-Golgi vesicle traffic and Golgi structure
rationale: Members are ER exit, COPII cargo loading, COPI anterograde/retrograde and intra-Golgi transport plus Golgi assembly, ribbon and localisation; confusables are Rab/ARF GTPase regulation or post-Golgi endosome-lysosome trafficking.

qualifier: COP9 signalosome deneddylation of cullin-RING ligases
name: Cullin neddylation and COP9 signalosome deneddylation
rationale: All members concern NEDD8 conjugation and its removal by the COP9 signalosome controlling cullin-RING ligases (e.g. CUL1-mediated NRF2 degradation); confusables are deubiquitinases, ubiquitin chain types or PD-L1 degradation.

qualifier: androgen and estrogen, including aromatase
name: Androgen and estrogen biosynthesis and metabolism
rationale: All members concern androgen and estrogen synthesis, regulation of testosterone production, androgen catabolism and aromatase (CYP19A1) deficiency; confusables are glucocorticoid/mineralocorticoid synthesis and adrenal CYP enzyme defects.

qualifier: vesicle clustering, endocytic recycling and active zone structure
name: Presynaptic vesicle clustering, endocytosis and active zone maintenance
rationale: Members cover synaptic vesicle clustering, endocytosis, clathrin uncoating and recycling with presynaptic active zone and cytoskeleton maintenance; confusables involve postsynaptic receptor internalization, clathrin coat assembly or neurotransmitter secretion control.

qualifier: cerebellar layering, brainstem and forebrain nuclei with motor coordination
name: Regional brain development: cerebellum, brainstem and forebrain
rationale: Members are development of cerebellar layers (granule, Purkinje, Bergmann glia), brainstem/hindbrain, thalamus, striatum and forebrain neurons plus motor learning and righting reflex; confusables focus on pons/hindbrain migration or locomotor behaviour.

qualifier: Rho-ROCK/PAK stress fibres in spreading, migration and platelets
name: Rho-ROCK/PAK actin remodelling in integrin adhesion and spreading
rationale: Members combine integrin/syndecan adhesion, cell spreading and migration with Rho-driven ROCK/PAK stress fibre assembly and platelet activation modules; confusables are fibronectin matrix assembly, PINCH-ILK focal adhesion or MET-PTK2 signalling.

qualifier: carnitine shuttle and synthesis with ketone body metabolism
name: Mitochondrial fatty acid beta-oxidation, carnitine shuttle and ketogenesis
rationale: Members are the stepwise acyl-CoA beta-oxidation spiral, carnitine synthesis/transport and ketone body synthesis/use; confusables are branched-chain/organic acid and cofactor metabolism or peroxisomal alpha-oxidation.

qualifier: calcium-triggered vesicle priming and fusion with short-term plasticity
name: Presynaptic calcium-triggered vesicle exocytosis and short-term plasticity
rationale: Members regulate synaptic vesicle priming, fusion and calcium-dependent exocytosis, spontaneous release and short-term potentiation at the active zone; confusables are transmitter-specific release cycles, vesicle docking/SNARE assembly or presynaptic calcium channel modulation.

qualifier: Notch and TSR protein O-fucosylation/O-glucosylation
name: Somite segmentation and Notch/TSR protein O-glycosylation
rationale: Members cover somite specification, axis elongation and tail morphogenesis together with Notch processing and O-fucose/O-glucose glycosylation (LFNG, B3GALTL); confusables are Nodal/BMP left-right, limb, neural plate or Hox patterning without glycosylation.

qualifier: sperm mitochondrial sheath and Sertoli barrier
name: Germ cell development, sperm mitochondrial sheath and Sertoli barrier
rationale: Members span primordial germ cell migration, germ cell proliferation/death and meiotic entry through sperm mitochondrial sheath assembly and Sertoli barrier formation; confusables are gonadal somatic cell/oocyte maturation or sperm motility.

core: Osteoblast and mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation
qualifier: with tendon and matrix (collagen, proteoglycan) synthesis
name: Osteoblast and mesenchymal stem cell expansion and differentiation
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast and MSC proliferation/differentiation (with Wnt), trabecular bone, tendon development and collagen/proteoglycan synthesis; confusables emphasise bone mineralisation, RUNX2-driven ossification or BMP-patterned mesenchyme.

qualifier: protein import, fission and pexophagy
name: Peroxisome biogenesis, protein import and pexophagy
rationale: Members are peroxisomal matrix and membrane protein import, receptor recycling, fission and selective autophagy of peroxisomes; confusables are peroxisomal lipid oxidation and synthesis.

qualifier: TLR2/4/5-MyD88/IRAK4 and NOD1/2-inflammasome sensing
name: Bacterial sensing via TLR2/4/5-MyD88 and NOD1/2
rationale: Members detect bacterial products (LPS, lipopeptides, lipoteichoic acid, peptidoglycan, muramyl dipeptide) through TLR2/4/5 with MyD88/IRAK4 deficiencies and NOD1/2/inflammasome signalling; confusables are downstream TAK1-MAPK, IPAF inflammasome or generic TLR/chemotaxis modules.

qualifier: CNS and PNS myelin formation/maintenance with axon calibre
name: CNS and PNS myelin formation, maintenance and axon calibre
rationale: Members cover central and peripheral myelin formation and maintenance, Schwann cell myelination initiation, oligodendrocyte progenitor proliferation and neurofilament-based axon diameter; confusables are node of Ranvier assembly, gliosis or oligodendrocyte differentiation control.

core: Leading-edge actin dynamics in cell motility
qualifier: filament severing, capping and depolymerization
name: Leading-edge actin turnover: severing, capping and protrusion
rationale: Members regulate actin polymerization, severing, barbed-end capping, depolymerization and Arp2/3 restraint to drive lamellipodia, ruffles and pseudopodia; confusables centre on WASP/WAVE Arp2/3 activation, macropinocytosis or actin crosslinking networks.

qualifier: cornification with desmosome and hemidesmosome adhesion
name: Epidermal cornification, desmosome/hemidesmosome adhesion and skin barrier
rationale: Members cover cornified envelope assembly, keratinocyte development and skin barrier with desmosome, hemidesmosome and anchoring fibril adhesion; confusables are integrin/laminin basement membrane, cadherin and cardiac intercalated-disc adhesion.
